elements.name: intro
elements.html:
Teaching {module} Self-paced Online Professional Learning

Post-Module Survey

Code.org relies on surveys as a crucial tool to stay connected to teachers, gather feedback about our curriculum and your teaching experience, and to improve our programs.

Privacy and Confidentiality

  • Your individual responses here are completely confidential.
  • Your identity will never be revealed publicly or used to tie any responses back to you personally.
  • We may share anonymous, aggregate data (representing all responses) publicly.
  • Your anonymized responses will be used by Code.org for program improvement.

Your honesty and candor are appreciated.

Teaching {module}: Post-Module Survey

elements.name: section1_goals
elements.html: The questions in this section aim to understand your experience with the Teaching {module} self-paced professional learning module.

elements.name: comfort_supporting_students_learn_aif_designing_building_ai
elements.title: After completing this module, I am more comfortable in my ability to support students in navigating the AI Foundations curriculum, identifying foundational AI concepts, and understanding best practices for managing AI in the classroom.

elements.name: comfort_supporting_students_learn_aif_ai_generated_design
elements.title: After completing this module, I am more comfortable in my ability to support students in using human-centered design practices to plan, build, and evaluate accessible websites.

elements.name: comfort_supporting_students_learn_aif_ai_algorithmic_decisions
elements.title: After completing this module, I am more comfortable in my ability to support students in understanding how programs are structured and behave, using JavaScript and visual planning tools.

elements.name: comfort_supporting_students_learn_aif_building_data_driven_systems_with_ai
elements.title: After completing this module, I am more comfortable in my ability to support students in understanding and working with data structures in real-world contexts.

elements.name: comfort_supporting_students_learn_aif_iterating_with_ai
elements.title: After completing this module, I am more comfortable in my ability to support students in applying loops to create interactive features, and in using AI tools responsibly in their code.

elements.title: After completing this module, I am more comfortable in my ability to support students in designing and building a purposeful web app while considering its ethical implications.
